---
name: Bug report
about: Something does not work
labels: bug
---

**What happened** (and what you expected)

**How to reproduce** (what you said or typed, what you clicked)

**Your setup** — Windows version, Eya commit or version, which AI you use (Gemini / Ollama / other), browser (Eya Browser / Chrome / Edge)

**Log lines** — from the terminal where you started Eya (`npm run dev`). **Remove anything private first:** keys, phone numbers, names, messages.

> Please do not paste API keys, chat contents or other private data. For a security problem, do not open a public issue: see SECURITY.md.
